General config, grouped the same way as the config file:
§bcapture volume limits§r (per blueprint type, game mode no longer matters),
§bper-player slot limits§r (counted by owner UUID),
§bpreview & distance§r, §blog retention§r.
§7Hover a section header for that section's full description.
spatial_blueprint.config.excluded.help:
Blocks that cannot be captured by blueprints - this list is the sole source.
Use [Add] to pick blocks from inventory; select to delete.
Takes effect on the server immediately after saving.
spatial_blueprint.config.substitutions.h:
Material list block substitution map: when the blueprint captures the
left-side block, it is recorded as the right-side block/item.
Format: sourceBlockId=targetBlockOrItemId, one per line.
Targets may list multiple items with '+', each counted once
(e.g. cauldron+water_bucket).
An empty target (source=) marks the block FREE (not counted).
Example: minecraft:water=minecraft:water_bucket
spatial_blueprint.config.bulk.help:
Bulk material conversion: when the captured source count reaches the
threshold, it is converted to a FIXED set of target items (e.g. 3 water
-> 2 water buckets; more water still yields 2).
Below the threshold the normal 1:1 substitution applies.
Threshold 0 = FREE (block not counted).

spatial_blueprint.config.upload.title: Config · Upload Security
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.help:
Server-side safety checks for uploaded
.schematic / .litematic projection files
(upload sanitize only; capture is unlimited).
These are enforced server-side only.
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.max_file:
§bMax raw file bytes
§7Compressed size checked BEFORE deserialization.
§cPrevents a highly-compressed NBT from
§cexpanding into a memory bomb.
§aDefault 20971520 (20MB)
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.max_dept:
§bMax NBT nesting depth
§7Scanned iteratively to stop maliciously-nested
§7NBT from crashing the server.
§7Not bypassed even by OPs.
§aDefault 8
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.max_bbox:
§bBounding-box volume limit
§7litematic lays out a dense index over the whole
§7box, so a huge sparse box wastes memory.
§aDefault 20000000
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.cooldown:
§bNon-OP upload cooldown
§7Minimum seconds between two upload attempts.
§aDefault 5 s

§bOP upload cooldown
§7OPs skip the per-minute cap but keep a minimal
§7cooldown so a stuck client can't spam.
§aDefault 1 s
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.max_per_:
§bUploads per minute (non-OP)
§7Max attempts inside a rolling 60s window.
§7Each upload does synchronous work on the main
§7server thread. OPs are exempt.
§aDefault 10
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.nbt_sing:
§bSingle block-entity NBT byte budget
§7Over budget = that block entity's NBT is CLEARED,
§7the block is kept; the file still uploads.
§aDefault 8192 (8KB)
spatial_blueprint.config.upload.nbt_tota:
§bTotal block-entity NBT byte budget
§7Sum over all block entities in the file.
§7Over budget = the whole file is REJECTED
§7(can't be fixed by clearing one block).
§aDefault 20971520 (20MB)
